title: OutpostEnrolmentAnswer
description: The door's answer to an enrolment (ADR 0147 §4): a pending instance, handed nothing until a person approves it by comparing its fingerprint. A daemon ignores a field it does not know.

instance_id.description: The `kid` of every later signature of this instance.

organisation.description: The organisation the token belonged to, for the operator to check.

outpost.description: The outpost the token belonged to.

fingerprint.description: `SHA256:` and the unpadded base64url SHA-256 of the raw signing key, as the door computed it: what the console shows, and what the daemon prints from its own key.

window.description: The protocol versions the door serves; a daemon below `minimum` is refused.
